text:
Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to various chronic diseases, aging, and inflammation. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health benefits, including reducing the risk of heart disease, preventing certain types of cancer, supporting immune function, and promoting overall cellular health and longevity.

The transparent material commonly used to make windows is glass.
